explanations: errorResponse uses the first entry in STATUS_BY_ERROR whose class matches with instanceof. Every domain error extends BookingError, and the base-class entry sits above the specific ones, so not-found, room-unavailable and reservation-closed errors all match [BookingError, 422] and the 404 and 409 entries are never reached. ValidationError only works because it happens to be listed above the base class. Ordering the table from most to least specific, with the BookingError catch-all after its subclasses, gives each error its intended status, and business-rule failures with no entry of their own still fall back to 422.
